🚨 *GLOBAL POLICY TRIGGERS ALERT*
• *Source/Speaker:* US Senate \(via Lindsey O\. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026\) \/ Former President Donald Trump
• *Announcement:* The US Senate has cleared a bill that could empower President Donald Trump to impose tariffs of up to 100\% on goods from countries, including India, if they are among the top five importers of Russian oil and gas\. \
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* MEDIUM \(75\% \- Proposed legislation passed by the Senate, but enactment and application to India are pending presidential action\. \)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* OGCs \(Indian refiners heavily reliant on Russian crude\), Metals\/Auto \(potential for retaliatory tariffs or broader trade disruptions affecting exports\), Infrastructure \(if trade flow impacts ports\/logistics\)\.
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(Increased geopolitical risk, potential for higher import bills and trade disruptions if tariffs are enacted, strengthening USD\/INR pressure likely\. \)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Re\-evaluate exposure to Indian refiners heavily reliant on Russian crude and exporters to the US\. Consider defensive plays amidst rising geopolitical uncertainty\.
